purpose: Define explicit revision/version evidence for mutable persisted records, separate from record semantic identity and suitable for conflict detection, audit and recovery.

topics.name: DWH Record Revision
topics.purpose: Define explicit revision/version evidence for mutable persisted records, separate from record semantic identity and suitable for conflict detection, audit and recovery.

semantics.record_rule: Record semantic identity remains stable across accepted revisions.
semantics.revision_rule: Each accepted mutation produces or references an explicit revision/version identity/value according to profile.
semantics.parent_rule: Revision may reference exact predecessor revision where history is maintained.
semantics.content_rule: Revision evidence binds to exact accepted semantic state/hash where applicable.
semantics.concurrency_rule: Expected revision participates in optimistic conflict control.
semantics.history_rule: Prior revisions are immutable evidence when retained.
semantics.identity_rule: Revision identity never replaces record semantic identity.
semantics.failure_rule: Uncommitted/failed write attempt does not become accepted record revision.

invariants.rule: Physical storage location, file name, engine page, snapshot artifact or backup copy never replaces canonical data/schema/instance identity; persistence and recovery operate on exact semantic identities with explicit version/provenance evidence.

hard_gates.condition: record revision used as record identity
revision missing from optimistic conflict check
same revision points to conflicting accepted content

references.purpose: Record revisions support exact conflict control.
Accepted writes create explicit revision evidence.

prose.summary: Define explicit revision/version evidence for mutable persisted records, separate from record semantic identity and suitable for conflict detection, audit and recovery.
